title: Only backlog.py check withholds a host or user name: list, tree, show, claim and done print it
goal: No backlog.py command prints a piece of this host's computer or user name: every output line (and a refusal on stderr) is masked, outside the project's repository paths, so a name in an item's title or a repro's output never reaches a terminal line an agent copies into a commit message. Found by the SP-2agxqrrv review.
